title: Error outside of context
description: iyi Ikiganiro igeze kuri AI's limit of memory, like a whiteboard filling up. We can expand the memory window (called context size) so it remembers more, but it can use more of your computer's memory. We can also truncate the input, which means it will forget some of the chat history to make room for new messages.
increaseContextSizeDescription: Wifuza ko ibara rya context rigabanuka?
lastRequestOverflowed: Ubutumwa bwa nyuma bwarengeje umubare w'amadosiye.
contextOverflowDetail: Ikibazo cyari gikeneye tokens {{request}}, ariko idirishya rya context rya model rifite gusa {{context}}.
emptyReply: Model finished without returning a reply. Try regenerating, or check the provider settings.

engine.unknown: Iyi mashini y'ishusho yagaragaje ikosa ridasanzwe.
engine.MODEL_ARCH_NOT_SUPPORTED: Ububiko bw'amaderese bw'iyi modoka ntibushyigikiwe n'umuyoboro usanzwe. Guhindura imiyoboro kuva mu Igenamiterere bishobora kongera gushyigikirwa.
engine.MODEL_LOAD_TIMED_OUT: Imodoka yafashe igihe kirekire cyane ngo ifungurwe, ikaba yarahagaritswe. A smaller model or a smaller context size usually helps.
engine.MISSING_SHARED_LIBRARY: A librerie the engine needs is missing, so it cannot start.
engine.GPU_DRIVER_TOO_OLD: Umukoresha wawe GPU ni muke cyane kuri iyi mashini. Guhinduranya umukoresha, cyangwa guhinduranya kuri iyi mashini CPU mu Igenamiterere, bizakemura iki kibazo.
engine.OUT_OF_MEMORY: Ububiko butari buhagije kugirango ukoreshe iyi model.A smaller model or a smaller context size usually helps.
engine.IO_ERROR: Icyemezo cyo ifile ntikabone cyangwa ntikabone mu gihe cyo gutangira ikimera.
engine.INTERNAL_ERROR: Icyo kintu cyagenze nabi muri Novera mu gutangira uyu murongo.
engine.ENGINE_UNREACHABLE: Injini llama.cpp ikora, ariko Novera idashobora kwihuza na yo kuri iyi mudasobwa (127.0.0.1). A VPN, porogisi cyangwa porogaramu y'umutekano ishobora kuba ibangamiye imibanire yo mu karere.
engine.ENGINE_STOPPED: i llama.cpp engine yahagaritswe ku bw'amahirwe. Kohereza ubutumwa busubiramo butangira busubiramo; NIBA bukomeza guhagarara, porogaramu y'ubwirinzi cyangwa i GPU musomyi bashobora kuba aribo babitera.
engine.UNSUPPORTED_CPU: Imodoka z'abanyagihugu ntiziterwa inkunga na processeur y'iyi mudasobwa. Injini y'abanyagihugu ya Novera yashyizweho kugirango ikoreshe Macs za Apple Silicon (M1 na za nyuma), bityo ntishobora gutangira ku Macs za Intel. Abatanga serivisi zo mu kirere n'abatanga serivisi z'abanyagihugu bakomeza gukora.
